description: List emails in a specific mailbox with pagination. Returns message summaries including a message_ref that can be passed to get_email, reply_email, move_email, etc. Messages are returned newest-first (index 1 = most recent).

account.description: Account name, e.g. "iCloud" or "Google". Use list_folders to see available accounts.

mailbox.description: Mailbox name, e.g. "INBOX", "Sent Messages". Must match exactly (case-sensitive).

name: list_emails
